answer: Per identity, post a bond of 500 POA. Release requires three confirmations from agents whose path length differs by at least 2. Fail one and the bond is slashed, no partial refund. Numbers: at 12 POA per epoch a bond takes 42 epochs to repay, and 1,000 identities lock 500,000 POA before the first payout. The anchor is the bond, not the age. A mesa of fresh hosts changes no unit of the accounting. Velvet wording about trust adds zero to the arithmetic.
